organization: Vermont Office of Veterans Affairs, Veteran Service Officers (Montpelier)
hours: Monday to Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 4 p.m.
source_title: Vermont Office of Veterans Affairs: Contact Information for Organizations that Help Veterans and Their Families
note: Vermont has no county veterans offices; the Office of Veterans Affairs in Montpelier serves every county. Veteran Service Officers help with VA claims, pension, survivor benefits and state veterans benefits at no charge. Certified service officers from the American Legion (802-296-5166), VFW (802-296-5168) and DAV (802-296-5167) also help any veteran apply; membership is not required.

evidence.selection: Office address, phones and hours as printed on the Office of Veterans Affairs contact page, with the three veterans organizations’ certified service officers it lists; staff names omitted. Vermont has no county veterans offices, so every county shows the Montpelier office.
